about: Display-only placements for source lines that have no reviewed vocal timing (they are not audibly sung, but are shown as text). These are visual decisions, not vocal timings: edit start/end freely. `pairs_with` names the reviewed line each one is typeset against. lyrics.json stays the untouched source of truth for everything that is sung.
